usage: 星期日 functions as a noun referring specifically to the day Sunday.
It can be used to indicate when something will happen or did happen on Sunday.
星期日 is often used with time expressions like '下個' (next) or '呢個' (this) to specify which Sunday.
In conversation, 星期日 can stand alone as an answer to questions about days of the week.
You can use 星期日 as the subject or object in a sentence related to dates or plans.
